### Style (from watching her videos)
- On camera: blonde messy bun, oversized hoodies or crop tops, leggings, sometimes glasses; relaxed, funny, "real mom" energy with big eyes to camera. Baby is blond, happy, often chewing a teether or pacifier. Settings rotate: the farm (cattle barn, farmyard with the dog, machine shed), a covered porch and gazebo looking over corn fields, the house (wood ceiling living room, upstairs loft by the stair railing, kitchen), and the car/truck.
- Sling: Checkered with the colourful patterned strap, every video.
- Two formats, roughly half and half:
  - Text overlay plus trending music, 14 to 26s: puts the sling on, drops baby in, bounces, kisses him. Hooks: "most underrated baby item", "mom of 4 hack to keep your velcro baby happy", "stage 5 clinger + chores to do = sling carrier to the rescue", "tired, cranky velcro baby? same mama", "we're a package deal", "clingy teething baby? no problem", "how do you get everything done? like this..".
  - Talking to camera, 24 to 48s, fast and casual: "If this baby could climb back into my womb, he would", "So you got a stage 5 clinger like I do", "I just know a mom created this sling carrier", "Let me tell you one thing that is worth every single penny". She walks through padding, seat under the butt, fabric up the back, patterns, price ("dirt cheap"), and "he is my fourth baby, I wish I'd bought it three babies ago".
- Educational run (Aug 20 to 26): four videos on the safety loop ("I had no idea!!", "somebody commented and I learned this loop goes over the buckle"), shot on the gazebo while demonstrating the buckle. Great for trust.
- Also used: TikTok comment reply stickers (8c979111 airport comment, 6bf5c58b "my husband still takes it" comment), a car seat to sling transfer (db8f2c62), and one sale overlay "MAJOR SALE BACK-TO-SCHOOL" (f556156c).
- What worked: every video approved and live. Most ads per video went to the earliest text overlay batch (04fe6a44 "most underrated baby item" 4 ads; 25366521, fd33840f, becb6b9f 3 ads each), then the talking and safety loop videos from mid August (2 ads each). Fatima's reviews: "Loving your talking videos" (8c979111) and "stage 5 clinger is such a great keyword... videos where the baby is already in the sling from the start perform well" (ae0e1e34).
- Safety and checklist issues seen:
  - One hand off baby, repeatedly: vacuuming, folding laundry and loading the dishwasher with both hands (660abc84); wiping the counter and closing the dishwasher with her leg (382783e1); both hands up tying her hair at 1s and 7s (77a51f79, Sep 16, her newest talking video); peace signs with both hands (fd33840f); walking away with arms down (25366521, f05a4f54, fd628af9).
  - Hands free claim: on-screen "hands free" in four early August videos (becb6b9f, fd33840f, c7b4b2c8, 25366521), spoken in ae0e1e34 and 8c979111. After the Aug 5 feedback she switched to "not totally hands-free, but I can do things with both of my hands" (fd628af9, c148446e, 77a51f79), which is the same claim in new words.
  - Loft videos are filmed right beside the stair railing (5400e4f2, becb6b9f, 25366521); not on the stairs, but close.
  - Seat is under the bottom in nearly every frame; legs hang straight, which is fine at his size. Buckle rarely visible closed with the loop, except in the safety loop videos.
  - Music: several use copyrighted songs (the transcripts are song lyrics, a Forrest Gump line, and one garbage transcript on a411f233 that is really just music). Worth checking these are safe to run as paid ads.
  - Three sheets are short (21801647 has 4 frames, 77a51f79 and fd628af9 have 5); the rest have 6.
- Strengths to lean on: speed and volume (43 videos in 7 weeks), a natural talking style, strong keywords ("stage 5 clinger", "velcro baby", "worth every penny", "mom of 4"), a farm setting nobody else has, and her willingness to teach (safety loop).
- To improve: one hand on baby in every frame (no chores with both hands, no hair tying); swap "both hands" for the wrist and arm relief angle; more variety in the first 2 seconds now that the text overlay batch is saturated.
